acceptance.statement: Sky, buildings, wall each have a distinct nonzero rate in a data table
Unit test: far layer moves less than near, wall most
acceptance.evidence: src/ui/parallaxData.test.mjs:7-12 (s < b < w at sway peak); passes when run directly; would fail without the module

findings.problem: src/ui/parallaxData.test.mjs is not in the npm test script, so CI/npm test would never catch a regression. package.json is outside allowedFiles, so the generator correctly did not edit it. Acceptable for this pass because the test passes when run directly (node src/ui/parallaxData.test.mjs -> 'parallaxData ok'), but it must be registered.
findings.fix: Director or an authorised agent adds the file to the npm test script.

findings.problem: Wall layer rectangles are widened only on the left; at max rightward sway the left edge sits at x=0 exactly, so no gap, but there is no margin.
Factors, 10 px amplitude, 12 s period are placeholders not in the GDD (flagged by generator).

requests: Add src/ui/parallaxData.test.mjs to the npm test script in package.json.
